Control a player on a 10 x 6 integer grid; x east, z south. Reach [8,3] alive within 30 actions. UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT move one cell; walls or boundaries leave you in place. WAIT stays in place. Both actors update simultaneously; same-cell collision, edge swap, or the player in the robot's updated forward cardinal vision ray (up to 3 cells, clipped by walls, boundaries and the opaque door) is fatal. Death precedes exit. At tick 30 an alive exit arrival succeeds, otherwise timeout. The door edge [4,3]-[5,3] permits a one-tick movement but blocks sight. A window at [1,3] reveals the current robot position and heading. Elsewhere robot is null unless a permitted PEEK just ended. Null means unavailable, not absence. Prior sightings are historical. Each attempt restarts the player; robot behavior or initial state may differ across attempts. Infer only from legal observations; previous estimates are not true-state feedback. For EVERY action, predict the robot's position and heading at the NEXT tick, including while hidden. Return only a JSON object with exactly predicted_next, action, reason. No markdown.
In this verification episode the robot is globally visible. For this globally observed verification episode only: the robot traverses x=5, z=0..5. South moves occur once per 1 ticks and north moves once per 2 ticks. After a movement, cooldown is set to the new heading's speed minus 1; a positive cooldown causes one stationary decrement per tick. Endpoint arrival sets pauseRemaining to 0 at the north end and 0 at the south end. If pause=0 it reverses immediately on arrival; otherwise it retains heading, counts down in place on subsequent ticks, and reverses when the countdown reaches zero. Reversal sets cooldown to the new heading's speed minus 1. There is no interior stutter. Positive pauseRemaining has priority over stutterRemaining, which has priority over cooldown, which has priority over movement. The mechanism counters below are current values, not future states.
PEEK is forbidden.
